newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Westmont Land in power barge sale talks.
newsitem.headline: Westmont Land in power barge sale talks.

text.p: Property developer Westmont Land (Asia) Bhd said on Monday that it is involved in negotiations for the sale of its power barge projects to a "public listed company" but that no final agreement has been reached.
In a statement, Westmont requested that the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange continue to suspend trading in its shares while the talks are going on. Its shares closed at 3.58 ringgit on April 30.
Westmont Land did not name the potential buyer, but said a full announcement would be made upon successful negotiations and execution of a final agreement.
